briefs.name: 连理柔线
briefs.shape: 柔和连续带面连接成对支撑，以左侧点折和开放下转保留礼林来源。
briefs.culture: 善心为舒展留白，善念为连续承接，善行为自然外展。
briefs.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE NEW contemporary corporate logo SYMBOL for 礼林生态 / LILIN ECO, company 达州礼林生态科技有限责任公司. The client rejected previous marks as too HARD in both COLOR and GEOMETRY. This is a genuine redesign of form and color, not a rigid mark with pastel recoloring. Primary feeling: soft, humane, airy, flowing, confident professional calm. Use curved transitions, lighter mass, moderate chroma, harmonious warm/cool midtones. Keep name-source 礼林 and values 善心善念善行; engineering and software live subtly in SHARED SUPPORT and CONNECTED PATHS. No collage of industry icons. Construction: ONE LIGHT SHARED-STROKE 礼林 emblem drawn from a gentle rounded continuous band. Two relaxed upright stems each branch ONCE with broad SOFTLY ROUNDED shoulders, sharing one quietly curved lower turn; one small soft-square dot and a left inward turn preserve 礼 source. Use flowing generous S-curves and breathing white bays, not a tree illustration, ordinary Chinese font, anchor, rigid bridge, angular brackets or outlined text. The shared support suggests engineering, its continuous pathway suggests software; these cues should be secondary to a humane calm memorable brand symbol. A wide but COMPACT open silhouette, 3 broad masses maximum, medium-light stroke weight, no pointy tips. Palette: Dusty blue #7694AE flowing into soft periwinkle #A49CC1, warm apricot #DEB293 as a restrained connecting accent. ONE centered standalone emblem on pure WHITE, ample margin. NO company lettering or captions: a neutral wordmark will be consistently added separately. Flat vector-like polished graphic, smooth contours, very restrained 2D gradients permitted, NO 3D, glass, glow, bevels, texture or shadows. NO high-saturation royal blue, bright red, neon lime, red-yellow-blue hard clash, sharp polygon tips, squared I-beams, blocky modules, exposed chips or gears. Do not wash the mark out into nearly invisible pastel, and do not imitate an established brand.

briefs.culture: 接纳空间、共用笔势与舒展末端分别承载善心、善念、善行。
